criteria.evidence: lib/faults.ts treatmentErrorStateAdvice/faultErrorStateAdvice put the fault's remediation on ErrorState and are spread at every ErrorState whose words come from a classified fault or that has the fault object at its render site (run-related, run-logs, run-detail, checkpoints-tab, timeline-tab, schedule-detail/edit, new-schedule, hook-list/deliveries, goal-list, audit, checks-list, run-list, workers-states, view-frame and the others in the diff), plus app/fault-error-state.svelte under the fault boundary and the three query-fault-banner components. faults.test.ts 'the fault-to-view mapping' asserts the remediation for one fault of each of the seven treatment kinds. Not covered, with no fault object at the site: boot-failure, route-outlet, home activity cards, models-section catalog failure, the stopped and canceled states, the refresh-failed Banners.

canRetryFault/treatmentErrorStateAdvice give onRetry only when retryable is not false. faults.test.ts: Retry present for retryable true, for a fault with no field, and for a non-wire error; absent for retryable false across every HttpClientError kind. fault-boundary.test.ts, the three query-fault-banner tests and schedules/fault-banner.test.ts assert the button; run-list-sentences.test.ts and faults.test.ts cover screens that read several things (Retry stays while any failed read can be retried). A fault that is not retryable and that Health explains keeps a way forward: Open Health in the row's action region (fault-boundary.test.ts).

fault-boundary.svelte draws app/fault-error-state.svelte, a Cinder ErrorState row (bordered), with the same remediation and Retry rule. Cinder first: ErrorState gained a warning tone and announce (round 0), then in design round 1 the row's bordered hairline (a quiet 1.5:1 edge from the tone's border token, light-dark mixes computed from the resolved tokens), a medium-weight title on its own line, and tests for the secondary action in both variants. conflict and unreachable are warning, not-found and not-supported neutral, the rest danger, all announced as alerts with announce. fault-boundary.test.ts asserts tone and role per kind, with assertions for remediation under the description and Retry present, absent and defaulted. The page's .weft-fault-boundary box is deleted from foundation.css, as is the reviews.css slot margin; only the details container for notes, field errors and the stack remains. Changed assertions: tones are read from data-cinder-tone on the ErrorState and the role from its body; the tinted fill is gone, so warning shows in the glyph and the hairline; notes sit under the box.

Remediation is rendered only through ErrorState's remediation prop, a paragraph after the description; no site passes it as title. A title with a subject is faultTitle(kind, subject), 'Couldn’t load ___', and never carries a server sentence (system/query-fault-banner.test.ts, fault-boundary.test.ts); the line follows the description in document order.
